title: Jeremiah's Temple Sermon
description: Jeremiah stands at the gate of the house of the Lord and warns the people not to trust in deceptive words that the temple is safe while they continue with theft, murder, adultery, false oaths, and idolatry. He reminds them how the Lord destroyed the sanctuary at Shiloh and warns that the same will happen to the temple in Jerusalem. The people have built high places for sacrifice in Topheth in the Valley of Ben-Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters. The Lord declares that the land will become a desolate waste without shouts of joy or gladness.
